content: .{@-सिंहः, -हरिः@} .²1 ‘a lion-like man’ a chief among men, an eminent or distinguished man. .²2 Viṣṇu in his fourth incarnation; अस्त्राण्यमोघमहिमानि निरूपितानि नो पस्पृशुर्नृहरिदासमिवासुराणि <ls>Bhāg. 1. 15. 16</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> नरसिंह. .²3 a particular mode of sexual enjoyment.  ˚चतुर्दशी fourteenth day of the bright half of Vaiśākha. ˚द्वादशी the twelfth day of the light half of Phālguna. ˚पुराणम् <ab>N.</ab> of an उपपुराण.
